findings.title: DSA-2026-324: Security update for Dell System Update (DSU) Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: Dell's advisory DSA-2026-324, published October 1, 2026, covers five DSU vulnerabilities, all affecting DSU versions prior to 2.3.0.0. The critical one, CVE-2026-86360, is a path traversal rated CVSS 9.6 that an unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit for arbitrary code execution with root privileges. The advisory credits Ori Gabriel with reporting CVE-2026-63697 and CVE-2026-86360, saltedfish with CVE-2026-86361 and CVE-2026-86362, and Nir Yehoshua of Cipher Security Labs with CVE-2026-71168, and directs customers to upgrade to DSU 2.3.0.0 or later.
